definitions.explanation: the quality of being moist or well-hydrated
a sense of richness, comfort, or emotional satisfaction in life

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}に{潤|うるお}いを{与|あた}える。
examples.english: To give moisture to the skin.

examples.japanese: {乾燥|かんそう}で{潤|うるお}いが{足|た}りない。
examples.english: It lacks moisture due to dryness.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}に{潤|うるお}いがない。
examples.english: There is no richness in life.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}に{潤|うるお}いを{与|あた}える{趣味|しゅみ}。
examples.english: A hobby that enriches the heart.

examples.japanese: {日常|にちじょう}に{潤|うるお}いをもたらす。
examples.english: To bring richness to daily life.

notes:
USAGE:
- {潤|うるお}いを{与|あた}える (to give moisture/richness)
- {潤|うるお}いがある/ない (to have/not have moisture/richness)
- {潤|うるお}いのある〜 (~ with moisture/richness)

SENSE 1 (Physical):
Often used in beauty/skincare contexts:
- {潤|うるお}い{成分|せいぶん} (moisturizing ingredient)
- {潤|うるお}いケア (moisture care)

SENSE 2 (Figurative):
Describes emotional richness or satisfaction:
- {生活|せいかつ}に{潤|うるお}い (richness in life)
- {心|こころ}の{潤|うるお}い (emotional fulfillment)

RELATED:
- {潤|うるお}う (to be moist; to profit)
- {潤|うるお}す (to moisten; to enrich)
- {渇|かわ}き (thirst; dryness - antonym)
